name: family_history_correction_after_denial
description: Regression case for a live transcript that surfaced four separate bugs at once. A patient answers the family-history question with a flat 'no', then a turn later volunteers a specific relative's finding instead of answering the pending safety question ('my mom had polyps actually') -- this must (1) not repeat the family-history question a second time, since it was already answered, (2) still change the final recommendation's risk tier and start age even though it arrived after a collective denial, (3) get an acknowledgment on the safety-question repeat it does cause, rather than a silent verbatim re-ask, and (4) a later bare 'yes' answering Daphne's own booking proposal must count as consent without being re-asked, and 'fridays after noon' must parse as Friday afternoon, not fall through to a best-effort soonest booking.

turns.content: I've never had a colonoscopy, and my doctor keeps bringing it up.
No, nobody in my family has had colon cancer or polyps.
No bleeding, no weight loss, no changes like that.
My sister can pick me up, no need for the number.
